title: Editorial Discovery and Market Intelligence Agent

approval.note: A composed script is a draft. A human reads it before this film is published anywhere.

script.vo01: Journalists watch primary sources by hand - listings, minutes, notices - and the watching only happens when there is time to do it. Market intelligence works the same way, gathered in bursts and held in different places by different people.
script.vo02: By the time a pattern is assembled, it is often already news to someone else.
script.vo03: It reads Court and public listings, Council minutes and public notices. It engages you in Microsoft 365 Copilot and Teams. And it can watch primary public sources continuously, showing the reasoning behind every answer.
script.vo04: A reporter asks what has surfaced in the week's public listings. The agent returns the items that break the usual pattern, each linked to the document it came from.
script.vo05: Asked how the story could be stood up, the agent proposes an order of work - the records to request, the parties to approach, and the claims that need a second source.
script.vo06: On risk, the agent marks what the documents do not say, notes where reporting restrictions may apply, and separates established fact from reasonable inference.
script.vo_payoff: Newsrooms see the public record as it changes rather than when someone finds the time to look.
script.vo_helps: The result? Monitoring that runs continuously, intelligence that arrives before it is asked for, and a shorter path from source to story.
script.vo_cta: Get started on your agentic journey today. Talk to your Microsoft representative to learn more.
